sections.heading: Gong Yoo — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Gong Yoo was born on 10 July 1979 in Busan, Dongnae District and Sumin-dong, and holds South Korean nationality. He was given the name 공지철 at birth and is publicly known as Gong Yoo.
He studied at Kyung Hee University and Busan Naesung Middle School.
